name: tres-ledger-link
description: Build a TRES Finance dashboard ledger URL (Transactions tab) with a precise filter set — date range, wallets, assets, tags, status, amount, and more — so it can be shared with a customer or reused. Use whenever the user asks for a "ledger link", "dashboard link", "filter URL", or "send <customer> a link to <some filtered view>". Scoped to the Transactions tab only (not Accounting, Roll Forward, Pivot Tables, Cost Basis, or Trial Balances).
